## Purpose

What problem does this change solve, and what behavior results?

## Decisions

Link relevant ADRs. If a consequential decision changes, update its record and index. For a routine change, write "No new ADR needed" and briefly explain if useful.

## Validation

State what was actually checked and the result. Distinguish documentation review, compilation, automated checks and manual playtesting. Include upstream revision and build environment when relevant.

## Remaining work

List concrete unverified behavior, known limitations or follow-up work. Do not describe a proposed feature as implemented.
